name: Tuner
description: '''Tuner''' (also capitalised as '''TUNER''' and '''TU-NER''') is an electronic rock trio formed by drummer/programmer [[Pat Mastelotto]] (of [[King Crimson]]) and touch guitarists [[Markus Reuter]] and [[Trey Gunn]]. Tuner has released six albums and also functions as a production team, having produced and arranged records for Tovah, Moonbound and [[Chrystabell]] and as remixers (having contributed to [[Steven Wilson]]'s ''Insurgentes Rmxs''). Mastelotto and Reuter also work together in [[Stick Men (prog band)|Stick Men]] and The Crimson ProjeKct.
